events.context: OPS-006 - learner-defined behavior matrix and expiry expectations
events.note: Learner chose the verification cases for the login slice and predicted their outcomes: 400 with one shared body for a missing or non-string email/password, one identical 401 for a wrong password and an unknown email, 401 for a missing or unknown session cookie, 200 with id/name/role for the current user, 401 for both expiry paths, and an unchanged appeals list. Predicted that an expired session is not extended (lastActivityAt stays as it was), which the mentor-run fixtures confirmed: lastActivityAt aged 31 min -> 401 with the row identical before and after, control at 29 min -> 200 with lastActivityAt advanced, createdAt aged 9 h with fresh activity -> 401 with the row untouched. One divergence found by the run: successful login answers 201 while the agreed contract says 200, which the learner aligns. Decorator spelling and expiry fixtures were mentor-supplied; the case set and the expected outcomes were the learner's.
